Terms of Use

These Terms cover playing Moonlit Beacon by Hyo Dev. Starting the game means you accept them alongside the Privacy Policy.

Guests play under a durable ID with a local journey on this installation. Cloud saves and ranks work only when signed in and the service is reachable.

The online Hall shows game ID and hero and score and rank. Ranks are best-effort: nothing here promises permanent records or instant sync.

Link an account or delete your data from account settings. Unlinked local data may be lost if you reinstall or clear storage.

Optional purchases follow each store's own payment and restore and refund procedures. This game adds no extra fees or refund windows.

Play fair: do not submit false records or spoil the game for others.

Personal data is handled as described in the Privacy Policy. For help use the support contact in Settings.

The game source is shared under the MIT License. Third-party engine font and art notices are listed in Credits.

Questions: hyo@hyo.dev
